prompt: A surreal high-fashion editorial series across dimensions, blending desert, ocean, sky, and crystalline structures. In Act I, a giant hyper-realistic tiger crouches at the boundary of desert and ocean, guarding a gothic cathedral throne. A futuristic model, dressed in an André Courrèges-inspired space-age outfit with glowing jellyfish tendrils, emerges from a ship. In Act II, she approaches a colossal floating blue cube forest above the clouds, mirrored in a glassy surface. The cube is covered in electric-blue foliage and appears unreachable, yet real. The sky is painted with golden vaporwave hues, the light cinematic and divine. In Act III, the model enters the crystalline interior: a sacred AI cathedral built from living data and refracted gems. Each realm is hyper-detailed, blending fashion, mythology, and architecture into a surreal editorial fantasy.
